text:
lina: Quick heads-up — we're targeting tonight's 22:00 UTC change window to roll r-3.2.0 across api, runtime, console, router. Need alignment on pinning, canary %s, and clear rollback triggers.

jordan: +1. Router needs a pin for the header schema change (breaking internal X-RD-User header). I propose pin router -> v3.2.0 and allow api/runtime to accept both header formats for the canary.

sam: Can we run a tiny runtime canary (2% traffic) with kv-eviction off? Kernel bfloat path flips in this build and I want kv behavior steady.

tess: Console will surface new model chooser UI. We can gate the UX behind a flag, but metrics dashboard names change — need to coordinate names today so alerting doesn't break.

deploy-bot: preflight checks queued for 1722223333.

deploy-bot: preflight: infra lint OK, schema diff detected (router header), canary policy OK, flakiness check pending.

jordan: Here's the pin command I ran in staging, for review: ```sh
rctl pin router v3.2.0 --reason "header-schema-stability"
```

lina: Good. Decision log: pin router at cutover, allow api/runtime to serve both header variants for 48h, then toggle strict header enforcement in api after metrics look good. Add to release notes.

sam: Rollback triggers I want:
- P50 latency > 120ms sustained for 5m on runtime-core
- Error rate spike > 0.8% on token generation endpoints
- KV miss rate rising > 10% over baseline
If any hit, we abort traffic shift and pin back to v3.1.9.

jordan: Add router-level 502 spike (>0.4%) and console metric name mapping failures as triggers.

lina: Agreed. I'll add a short checklist to release notes and the runbook. Who owns the quick rollback command?

oncall-sre: I'll be on pager for the window and can run the rollback. Rollback commands: ```sh
# router rollback
rctl pin router v3.1.9 --force --note "rollback 1722223333"
# runtime rollback (drain new pods, redeploy old image)
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=image:3.1.9 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime
```

_tess: Can console feature flags be toggled independently? I can leave model chooser behind a FF so UX toggles are immediate if we hit regression._

lina: Yes, leave it behind FF. We only enable the user-facing chooser after 2h of stable canary metrics.

deploy-bot: canary plan created: [api] 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 20m, [runtime] 2% -> 15% over 30m, router pinned at cutover. Automated rollback hooks configured for latency/error guards.

jordan: Release notes draft: short bullets + link to runbook. Adding compatibility note for integrators about X-RD-User header. Link: <https://redwood-internal/release-notes/r-3.2.0>

sam: Need a quick smoke script to exercise kv cache, generation and header combos. I'll drop it in #eng-releases in 30m.

lina: Action items:
- sam: put smoke script + run locally (before 21:00 UTC)
- tess: keep console behind FF and add dashboard mapping shim for alerts
- jordan: pin command ready in distro; confirm staging rollback test done
- oncall-sre: be ready to execute rollback and own morning triage if needed
- deploy-bot: run preflight 60m before window and post status in this thread

jordan: ACK. staging rollback tested, timeline noted.

oncall-sre: ACK. I'll stay on until 01:00 UTC as safety window.

lina: Thanks team. I'll post final release note blurb and the runbook snippet 1h before window here. :rocket:

deploy-bot: preflight scheduled at 21:00 UTC, will post results. Good luck!
